SYNTHETIC POUCHOSCOPY REPORT
Date of service: 03/14/2031
Endoscopist: Corvin Ashdale, MD (fictional)

History: The patient has an ileal pouch-anal anastomosis after a total proctocolectomy.
Findings: The endoscope was advanced through the anus into the pouch and into the pre-pouch ileum for 15 cm.
Biopsies of the pouch were taken with cold forceps.
